description: Name the bank behind an IBAN: registered bank name, BIC/SWIFT code and the address where the register publishes one, plus whether the IBAN is structurally valid, its country and that country's SEPA status. This is the tool for a payment instruction - reach for validate_iban instead when only the typing needs checking, and get_country_iban_format when there is no IBAN in hand yet. Where no bank comes back the result says why: a bank code that was never issued reads differently from one we hold no record for, and neither is ever guessed at. Takes up to 50 IBANs in one call and answers each separately. Requires an X-Api-Key header, and costs one bank lookup from the caller's monthly allowance however many IBANs the call carried.

ibans.description: The IBANs, exactly as they were written down. Spaces, lower case and the grouped form a bank prints on a statement are all accepted, so nothing needs normalising first. Up to 50 in one array, and sending the whole list in a single call costs the same as sending one IBAN. Each entry is answered on its own, so a malformed one comes back marked invalid beside the others rather than failing the call.

name: analyze_iban
title: Resolve IBANs to their banks
